purpose: First bounded offline real LiDAR-pose/raw-IMU fusion pilot; no production LIO, speed, GPU or calibrated uncertainty claim

lidar.scan_coordinates: velodyne_sync body z up at axle; legacy velodyne header

initialization.gravity: -9.81 * body_up_from_rpy(last raw ms25_euler roll/pitch at or before first scan, max age .05 s), in first LiDAR body world
initialization.velocities: Second-order finite differences of all LiDAR-derived IMU-origin positions; offline, includes future LiDAR poses; lever arm included
initialization.bias: zero gyro/accel; no ground-truth initialization, calibration or tuning

windows.selection: All consecutive valid-IMU runs, greedily disjoint chunks <=16; discard tails <4; no crossing invalid edges; no splicing as continuous LIO

noise.purpose: Fixed diagnostic model inherited from numerical probes; not sensor/pose covariance calibration

evaluation.truth: Original body reference rows, z-up conversion only; separate evaluator opens truth after estimated outputs are frozen
evaluation.matching: Both bracketing GT rows within .05 s, interpolate xyz and SLERP SO3, no extrapolation
evaluation.primary: Pooled consecutive SE3 RPE translation and rotation RMSE on exactly the same within-window edges
evaluation.secondary: Per-window SE3 position-aligned ATE (no scale) pooled over nodes; window endpoint SE3 RPE
evaluation.coverage: Report all scans, rejected IMU edges, excluded short runs/tails, eligible windows/nodes/edges, solver nonconvergence
evaluation.comparison: LiDAR-only and fused estimates from identical actual scans; all eligible windows retained regardless of score
evaluation.adoption: Pilot only. Do not enable default fusion; improvement would require primary translation and rotation RPE in both sessions without material regression and later independent validation

limitations: Shared-map LiDAR pose priors are correlated; diagonal priors are an explicit approximation.
Adjacent factors may share a clipped held measurement at scan endpoints; ignored edge cross-covariance.
Within-interval bias diffusion and clock residuals are not calibrated.
Fixed gravity from one sensor attitude; velocity and pose priors reuse the same LiDAR estimates.
Single first-order bias correction; inspect correction sizes, not certified validity.
NCLT reference uses SLAM/RTK and interpolated odometry; not statistically independent sensor truth.
Bundled scans are thinned and sampled about 0.8 s; synchronized sweeps are already motion compensated.
